<div class="sheet">

  <div class="ws-head">
    <div>
      <h1>Review Loop Design Canvas</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">Design a draft-review-revise quality loop with a fixed verdict vocabulary, parallel reviewer proxies and a named synthesiser of conflicting fixes, ready to encode as primitives.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-CS-HB-review-loop</b><br>
      Pack Z &middot; fill order 13 &middot; canvas<br>
      format <b>A3 landscape</b><br>
      audience <b>eng-leader</b>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-source">
    Source: <b>Writing a ~68,000-Word Book with Agent Fleets</b> &middot; The Draft&rarr;Review&rarr;Revise Cycle &middot;
    <code>case-study-handbook-writing.qmd</code> L130-166 &middot;
    <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/case-study-handbook-writing.html#sec-cs-handbook-review-cycle">#sec-cs-handbook-review-cycle</a> &middot;
    "Every chapter passed through an identical three-stage pipeline. This is the core quality loop" &middot;
    Fill first: <code>WS-12-agent-persona-design-canvas</code>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    Design your own loop. Region A is the loop itself: one answer per decision, filled once. Region B is the reviewer roster: one row per proxy, and each row must stand in for a named real person's reading. Bring one of those people. The grey cells are the book's case, printed as an example to compare against, not an answer to copy. Write the complete, closed list of verdicts in A8 before you fill any proxy's column 6. Then encode all of it as primitives within the week.
  </div>

  <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:49% 49%;column-gap:2%;align-items:start">

          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><small>The complete, closed set of verdicts a reviewer may return, one word each. Free-text verdicts are prohibited by construction.</small></td>

    <p style="font-size:7.4pt;margin:2mm 0 0">The three grey rows are the book's case, printed as an exemplar. The case names the lenses but does not give persona files, blocking or precedence, so those cells print a dash. Proxies that receive identical context in B5 are one proxy. Two proxies at the same rank in B8 need an explicit rule in A10.</p>

    <h2 style="margin-top:4mm">The case's own loop <span class="ws-block-note">exemplar, not a fill area</span></h2>
